abstract.t: This document specifies the Runtime Contract Negotiation Substrate (RCNS) for the Agent Transfer Protocol (AGTP) [AGTP]: the mechanism by which an AGTP server synthesizes an endpoint at runtime, from registered primitives, when a caller addresses a method and path pair the server has yet to register. RCNS is invoked explicitly through the PROPOSE floor method and implicitly when a server is configured to treat unregistered requests as synthesis candidates. The document defines the four-lock dispatcher gate that governs when synthesis may occur, the two contract delivery modes, the PROPOSE request and response body shapes, recipe versioning, contract scoping and lifecycle, the headers and rate-limiting contract, the Attribution- Record extension fields that make every invocation served under a contract attributable, and the inventory surfaces through which contracts are observed. The material was previously carried in [AGTP-API], which this document and [AGTP-METHODS] together replace.
